Equipment
 Speed Governor of Hydraulic Turbines

This document outlines the preliminary adjustments for watt transducer 
 amplifier modules that have not been in service or the major maintenance 
 procedure P1 which must be performed every four years as indicated by Y4 in the 
 title block

The main functions of governor are sense turbine speed control speed in a 
 stable manner and provide for load sharing between units

This document initiated by eng. Mahmoud Sayed Mahmoud, tested by eng. Hassan 
 Ahmad Abou El-Haggag, accepted by eng. Selim Ahmad Aly Selim, accepted by eng. 
 Abd el-Naby Abd El-Ghany High Dam Hydraulic Power 
 Station head sector and certified by eng. Mohamed Osama Soliman: HPGC quality 
 general director & MPIS coordinator

items:
A work permit must be issued, the 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety ID category

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required

Wear the safety and healthy 
 protective equipment as safety shoes, helmet .... etc

Turn the transfer switch to "off" 
 position as request

Run the unit on line and loading 
 at several setting as request
Set of common and screw drivers

Digital multimeter and oscilloscope 
 "two channels or more"
Extender card
Set P-1 for 29.36 k from PIN # 13 to junction of P-1 and R-1 (figure 1)
Set P-2 for 30.66 k from PIN # 14 to junction of P-2 and R-3 (figure 1)

Set P-3 for 22.61 k from PIN # 4 to junction of P-3 and R-9 
 (figure 1)
Adjust P-1 for 8.4 k from PIN # 7 to P-1 slider
Pull the voltage comparator module # out of rack

Raise 65UGP (unit generation potentiometer) to 200 on the dial and adjust 65 
 UGP/CAL (Calibration potentiometer) for 8.49 volts between EA-2 and EA-3 (CT) 
 lower 65 UGP to "zero" on the dial
Lift KK-63 to keep 52X-1, 52X-2, 52X-3 relays from operating

Lift wire KK-6/HN-15 at 52X-2 relay to keep the gate limit from running to 
 full gate (85%) when UCB is closed
Lift KK-20 to take 65PSD (partial shutdown) out of service
Lift KK-45 so the gate limit can be raised above 30% after UCB is closed

Turn the transfer switch to "off" position and put the watt transducer 
 amplifier module on an extender card, turn the transfer switch to "Gov" 
 position and reset lock-up

Synchronize the unit to the system, raise the speed adjustment to raise 
 the gate setting to the gate limit
Raise the gate limit so the gate position pointer is on 50%

With the voltage comparator # 1 pulled and 65 UGP set at "zero" jumper PIN 
 #13 on the watt transducer amplifier to CT (PIN #8) , (figure 1)

Adjust P-2 on the watt transducer amplifier for 5.240 volts from (output 
 #1) blue test jack (L1) to (CT) yellow test jack (figure 2)

Adjust P-3 on the watt transducer amplifier for 4.245 volts from (output # 
 2) blue test jack (L2) to (CT) yellow test jack (figure 2)

Remove the jumper (from PIN # 13 to CT) placed on the watt transducer 
 amplifier in step # 10 and plug the voltage comparator #1 in, the 65UGP dial 
 should go 100 2

Lower the load with the speed adjustment and disconnect the unit from 
 system
Reconnect KK-63, KK-6/HN-15, KK-20 and KK-45

Synchronize the unite to the system and load the unit with 65 UGP to 50% 
 gate
Lift MA-19 (CT) to disable the speed sensor

If they do overshoot : turn P-1 on the unit loading gain amplifier 
 device "EG" : CCW

If they stop short and then drift : turn P-1 on the unit loading gain 
 amplifier device "EG" CW

Check that the wicket gate opening is twice the setting on the 65 UGP dail 
 1% at several setting if not : adjust P-1 on the watt transducer amplifier 
 until they are

Reconnect MA-19, the wicket gate opening will agree with 65 UGP set point 
 only if the frequency is 50 HZ

Disconnect the unit from the system and shut it down, turn the transfer 
 switch to "off" position, remove the watt transducer amplifier from the 
 extender card and plug into the rack turn the transfer switch to "Gov" 
 position and reset the lock-up
